Generate a U-shaped profile by subtracting an offset rectangular box from a larger one, ensuring both ends remain open. The larger box should measure 450 mm in length, 70 mm in width, and 40 mm in height. Subtract an inner box that is 60 mm wide and 35 mm and high with same 450mm length, maintain a wall thickness of 5 mm around the sides and base, resulting in a U-shape, open at the top and sides | First, describe in words and step by step how the user's request can be implemented using function calls only. After the description, I will ask you to prepare the function call for execution, but don't execute it until I explicitly request it.

Step-by-step implementation logic (no function calls yet)

1. Establish the reference point  
   • Place the profile so its bottom-front-left corner sits at the global origin (0 ,0 ,0).  
   • All other coordinates are measured from that point.

2. Create the solid outer volume (the “blank”)  
   • Dimensions: X-length = 450 mm, Y-width = 70 mm, Z-height = 40 mm.  
   • Insert one block with x_size [450], y_size [70], z_size [40].  
   • Basepoint lists x [0], y [0], z [0].  
   • subtraction [False] because this is the starting (positive) geometry.

3. Carve out the inner channel to obtain the U-shape  
   • Wall requirements: 5 mm bottom and 5 mm on each side.  
   • Therefore the inner cavity begins 5 mm above the base in Z, ends flush with the top (5 + 35 = 40 mm), and is 35 mm high.  
   • It also starts 5 mm in from the left side (Y), has a width of 60 mm, and ends 5 mm before the right outer face (5 + 60 + 5 = 70 mm).  
   • Along X the cavity runs the full 450 mm so that both ends stay open.  
   • Insert a second block with x_size [450], y_size [60], z_size [35].  
   • Basepoint of this inner block: x [0], y [5], z [5].  
   • subtraction [True] so it is removed from the first block.

4. Resulting geometry  
   • A 450 × 70 × 40 mm channel section.  
   • 5 mm thick side-walls, 5 mm thick base, no top, no front/back walls—hence a U-profile, open at the top and at both ends.
